mainEntity.name: What is AEO and how does it benefit cosmetic surgeons?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO stands for Answer Engine Optimization. It's a strategy focused on optimizing your online content to be directly answered by AI-powered search engines and voice assistants. For cosmetic surgeons, this means increasing visibility when potential patients ask questions like "What is a facelift?" or "How long is recovery after breast augmentation?" By providing clear, concise, and authoritative answers, AEO helps your practice appear prominently in search results, driving more qualified traffic to your website and establishing your expertise.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO optimizes your online content for AI search engines and voice assistants, helping cosmetic surgeons gain visibility and attract patients by directly answering common questions.
